components.name: Action
components.summary: A button that triggers a host capability.

components.name: ActionBar
components.summary: The set of actions for a surface or section; the renderer places it where that platform expects.

components.name: ActionMenu
components.summary: Secondary actions behind one control: an overflow menu, dropdown, split button or context menu.

components.name: Confirm
components.summary: Asks the user to confirm a consequential or destructive action, showing what will happen.

components.name: TextInput
components.summary: A single text-like value: text, number, email, phone, currency, search or long text.

components.name: Choice
components.summary: Pick one or several options from a known set. The renderer chooses the control.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: An on/off setting.

components.name: DateInput
components.summary: A date, time, date-time or date range.

components.name: RangeInput
components.summary: A number, or a range between two numbers, within known bounds.

components.name: Form
components.summary: Collects inputs and submits them together.

components.name: FileInput
components.summary: Choose or drop files to upload.

components.name: ColorInput
components.summary: Pick a colour or a swatch.

components.name: CodeInput
components.summary: A one-time code or PIN, typed into boxes.

components.name: Rating
components.summary: Give or show a score out of N.

components.name: Text
components.summary: A run of text.

components.name: Metric
components.summary: A key figure with a label, and optionally its change.

components.name: DetailList
components.summary: Label/value pairs describing one thing (a summary, a receipt, a review step).
covers: Contact a department or service team

components.name: Table
components.summary: Tabular data: many items sharing the same attributes.

components.name: Collection
components.summary: A list of items from host data, each rendered with the same template.

components.name: Chart
components.summary: A visual summary of data, always paired with a text summary.

components.name: Media
components.summary: An image, video, audio clip, gallery or QR code supplied by the host.

components.name: Status
components.summary: Feedback about state: info, success, warning, error, empty or loading.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: A short label, status or count attached to something else.

components.name: Identity
components.summary: A person, team or organisation: picture, name and details.

components.name: Tree
components.summary: A hierarchy people expand, browse and pick from.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: How far along something is, or an amount within bounds: bars, rings, meters, gauges.

components.name: Code
components.summary: Code or preformatted text, copyable.

components.name: Section
components.summary: A titled region of the surface that groups related content under a heading.

components.name: Group
components.summary: Visually groups closely related items without a heading (proximity).

components.name: Card
components.summary: One self-contained entity (an account, an order, a place), optionally actionable as a whole.

components.name: Columns
components.summary: Side-by-side columns that collapse to a stack on compact layouts: a main column with a narrower one beside it, or equal halves.

components.name: Split
components.summary: Master and detail side by side: a list that stays while the chosen item's detail shows beside it; on compact layouts the detail replaces the list.

components.name: Disclosure
components.summary: Progressive disclosure: secondary content hidden behind a toggle.

components.name: Views
components.summary: Switch between alternative views of the same subject (tabs).

components.name: Steps
components.summary: A task split into ordered steps with visible progress.

components.name: Comparison
components.summary: Compare a few options across the same attributes, and choose one.

components.name: FilterPanel
components.summary: Filters for a list of results, with the result count.

components.name: Navigation
components.summary: The product's main navigation.

components.name: Panel
components.summary: Content opened over the current view: a dialog, drawer, sheet or popover.

components.name: Frame
components.summary: The product's frame: the regions around its screens (header, navigation, main, aside, footer, banner), with an outlet where screens and generated surfaces appear.

components.name: AppBar
components.summary: The bar at the top of the product: brand or title, a leading action, search, trailing actions and the account.

components.name: Footer
components.summary: The bar at the bottom of the product: link groups, the legal line, locale or status.

components.name: Outlet
components.summary: Where the current screen renders inside a Frame: the host fills it with a screen document or a generated surface.

components.name: Custom
components.summary: A slot for a component the host implements itself: a logo, a brand moment, a bespoke widget. The document names it and gives it props; the product renders it, and a fallback stands in when it can't.

foundations.name: color
foundations.summary: Surfaces, text, borders, actions, selection, status and data colours, in every mode

foundations.name: type
foundations.summary: The type scale: display, headings, body, captions and numerals

foundations.name: space
foundations.summary: Inset and stack spacing, tight to spacious

foundations.name: size
foundations.summary: Control heights and the minimum touch target

foundations.name: radius
foundations.summary: Corner radii for controls, cards and overlays

foundations.name: measure
foundations.summary: The longest comfortable line of text

foundations.name: shadow
foundations.summary: Shadows for raised and overlay surfaces

patterns.name: Compare and choose
patterns.summary: Put a few options side by side on the same attributes, mark what is better, recommend when there's a clear fit, and let the user choose.

patterns.name: Confirm a consequential or destructive action
patterns.summary: Before something that is hard or impossible to undo, say exactly what will happen and ask for an explicit, specific confirmation.

patterns.name: Filter and browse
patterns.summary: Narrow a large set with a few filters placed before the results, and explain empty results.

patterns.name: Multi-step form
patterns.summary: Collect information in small, ordered chunks: one form when short, Steps when long or dependent.

patterns.name: Review and submit
patterns.summary: Before committing, show everything that will be submitted in a scannable summary, then one clear submit action.

patterns.name: Undo instead of confirm
patterns.summary: For everyday actions that can be reversed, do them straight away and offer Undo, instead of asking 'Are you sure?' every time.

renderer.name: loading
renderer.summary: Skeletons, spinners and progress while data arrives

renderer.name: field
renderer.summary: Labels, help text, required marks and error text around every input

renderer.name: action-feedback
renderer.summary: Toasts and snackbars after an action, with Undo for reversible ones

renderer.name: hint
renderer.summary: Tooltips and help on hover or focus

renderer.name: icon
renderer.summary: Icons, from the design system's own set

renderer.name: overflow
renderer.summary: Truncation and overflow menus for what doesn't fit

renderer.name: form-errors
renderer.summary: Error summaries at the top of a form

renderer.name: navigation-toggle
renderer.summary: Opening and closing navigation on small screens
